The '''''Ninka''''' was a [[Free Virgillia-class Bunkerbuster|''Free Virgillia''-class Bunkerbuster]] in service of the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]]. Its [[commanding officer]] was [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

After the [[Atterra campaign]], the Resistance [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|bomber]] [[squadron]]s [[Cobalt Squadron|Cobalt]] and [[Crimson Squadron]] were transported aboard the ship back to [[D'Qar]] so they could help with the Resistance's [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of their [[Resistance base|base]].<ref name="Cobalt Squadron" /> The ''Ninka'', alongside the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']], the ''[[Vigil]]'' and the [[Anodyne (Nebulon-C)|''Anodyne'']], escaped to the [[Crait system]]. Unbeknownst to them, the First Order had [[Hyperspace tracker|tracked]] them through [[hyperspace]] and began an [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] on the [[fleet]]. The ''Vigil'' was destroyed during an attack by [[laser]] fire from the ''[[Supremacy]]''. After [[Poldin LeHuse]] and another [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter|TIE fighter]] destroyed the primary bridge of the ''Raddus'', the ''Ninka'' shot both of them down in retaliation.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

After outrunning the First Order for hours, the ''Ninka'' ran out of fuel and was quickly destroyed by the ''Supremacy'' as its crew evacuated.<ref name="Episode VIII" />
